meta.title: k8s(resources): tune workloads and add pedrobot db
meta.body_summary: Tune CPU/memory resource requests and limits across multiple Kubernetes workloads and add a MongoDB StatefulSet for the pedrobot application.

perf_labels.notes: Small-scale resource tuning and MongoDB addition across many YAML files; merged within ~15 minutes with only a non-blocking bot suggestion about probes.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1000 changed lines across 31 files, this is a medium-sized edit by absolute volume, but the changes are primarily repetitive resource value adjustments in YAML manifests. It fits a low-risk infrastructure tuning PR that merged quickly with no human review blocking.

review_details.concern_detail: Copilot bot suggested adding readiness/liveness probes for the new MongoDB StatefulSet; no human reviewer addressed it, and it did not block the merge.
review_details.performance_claim: Resource request tuning improves CPU/memory allocation efficiency and the MongoDB addition supports pedrobot performance.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Resource tuning and adding a DB statefulset are straightforward infrastructure changes; Codex faced no blocking challenges and merged with only a non-blocking bot suggestion.

detection_detail.code_reading: No evidence of human code-reading review; only bot review was present.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after performance benchmarks or load tests; only YAML validation via kustomize build commands is documented.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions detected; PR merged without revert or follow-up fixes.

core_change_summary.description: Adjust CPU and memory requests/limits across 31 Kubernetes YAML files spanning applications, infrastructure, and network controllers; add a new MongoDB StatefulSet for pedrobot; normalize resource quoting and clean up comments.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most files only had minor resource value adjustments; substantial changes include new MongoDB definitions and documentation updates.
change_trajectory: Initial commit (03c3edf): bulk resource tuning and MongoDB StatefulSet addition across all workloads.
Second commit (c9759e8): cleaned up YAML comments and added documentation about AI usage.

review_signals.summary: Suggested adding readiness and liveness probes for the MongoDB container to prevent premature traffic routing.
Copilot reviewed 31 files, generated one comment about probes, and noted three low-confidence nitpicks; no blocking issues.
Cloudflare Pages deployment successful; no performance feedback.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with resource tuning and MongoDB StatefulSet.
Cloudflare Pages bot reported successful deployment preview.
Copilot bot left a non-blocking review suggesting probes.
Owner merged within ~15 minutes with no human interaction or blocking requests.
